runs.cmd: curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:27500/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-11-25","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"raw","version":"0"}}}' | grep -iE '^HTTP|mcp-session-id|content-type'

data: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"tools":[{"description":"Count whitespace-separated tokens in text.","inputSchem
